spans.s:
mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Dried partially, consolidated, coagulated.
E.
आङ् dimin. श्यान dry.

n. (-स्यं)
1 The face.
2 The mouth.
mfn. (-स्यः-स्या-स्यं)
Belonging or relating to the mouth or face.
E.
अस to throw or direct, and ण्यत् affix, or आङ् before स्यन्द to go, and ड affix; to which food goes or is directed.
f. (-स्या)
Stay, abiding, resting.
E.
आस to sit, and ण्यत् aff.

n. (-त्रं)
A lotus.
E.
आस्य a face, and पत्र a leaf; this flower is commonly compared to a beautiful face.

m. (-लः)
A hog, a boar.
E.
आस्प and लाङ्गल a plough; whose face is as it were a plough.

n. (-म)
The beard.
E.
आस्य and लामन् hair; the hair of the face.

m. (-वः)
Spittle, saliva.
E.
आस्य the mouth, आसव liquor.
